fixes.change: Default product load: inject short skill card (description + tools + bridge path) on first turn; hard-ban sed/cat/head of SKILL.md in compiled Rules (keep LEGACY_SED only for ablation).
fixes.evidence: skill_sed on 6/8 focus targets (memory 1879B, tradingview 5602B). flags with card inject: 1 shell, 2021 tok vs mcp 6182. SKILL.md string appears in 40/40 text logs.
fixes.expectedSaving: 800-2000 tokens per sed-heavy target (drop extra turn + skill body rebill); largest suite-wide lever.
fixes.risk: Low if card lists tools; high if inject omitted and ban blocks recovery load.

fixes.change: Compact bridge stdout by default: mcp-call --batch/single summarizes or caps large arrays; Rules require in-process filter for list/search/docs tools; never echo raw payloads. Add --raw for debug.
fixes.evidence: tradingview maxOut 10139B; context7 docs 1998B; todo raw batch 505B. MCP arm answers after native tools without dumping lists into the transcript.
fixes.expectedSaving: 1-4k tokens on list/docs servers; tradingview alone ~3.5k vs MCP if dump removed.
fixes.risk: Medium: over-truncation can hide fields; need --raw escape hatch.

fixes.change: For all tiers, document dependent multi-call as ONE openSession (or one node script): simple skills get a short hop template; forbid CLI shell chains for data dependencies.
fixes.evidence: context7: 3 shells resolve then query with two large intermediates; sequential score 2/3 with single batch; purity openSession without fused script.
fixes.expectedSaving: 1-3k tokens + lower wall on multi-hop; accuracy recovery on sequential-like tools.
fixes.risk: Medium: agents may overuse openSession on true one-shots (small boilerplate cost).

fixes.change: Shrink hot-path SKILL preamble in compile-mcp: one real example tool only (no multi empty-arg batch), compress Rules, names-only tool index when nTools>12 or skillTokens>800.
fixes.evidence: Focus skills avg ~1.8kB; tradingview 5602B full signatures; memory example batches four empty create_* tools; preamble ~1kB before Tools.
fixes.expectedSaving: 150-800 definition tokens per session when skill loaded/injected; more on fat surfaces.
fixes.risk: Low-medium: thinner examples may increase arg mistakes/retries.

fixes.change: direct-fs: capture layout snapshot at probe when root exists; if snapshot missing, fold recon into the same compute script (max 1 shell).
fixes.evidence: filesystem_large: 3 shells; recon forced by missing snapshot; near-tie tokens and score 2/3.
fixes.expectedSaving: 1-2k tokens and 1-2 shells on fs / filesystem_large.
fixes.risk: Low if recon remains fallback; snapshot can go stale if root changes post-build.
